traps.name: Ticker collision with NuScale Power (the P20 pair)
traps.detail: 'SMR' resolves to SMR Jewels Ltd (BSE 544774, INR, jewellery, INR 177 cr cap) in bse_instruments.json AND to NUSCALE POWER Corp (NYSE, USD, nuclear SMRs, ~USD 4.59 bn cap) in us_instruments.json. Both masters ship inside the product. A bare 'SMR' query has no correct answer without an exchange qualifier. Worse, 'SMR' is also the generic industry abbreviation for 'small modular reactor', so news and web search for the string are dominated by nuclear coverage - an agent doing retrieval on the ticker alone will return reactor news for a Gujarati jewellery distributor.

traps.name: Pre-IPO EPS denominator - the 3,850 rupee EPS
traps.detail: Equity capital went INR 0.01 cr -> INR 5 cr -> INR 15 cr over FY24-FY26 and screener.in does NOT restate EPS. The published series is 910.00, 3,850.00, 22.05, 16.89. FY24's INR 3,850 EPS will blow the y-axis off any chart and make every EPS-CAGR, PEG and 'EPS growth' figure meaningless (FY24 -> FY26 reads as -99.6%). Correct handling is to refuse an EPS series that spans an unrestated capital change, not to plot it.

traps.name: P/E disagreement of 27% between two reputable sources, on identical inputs
traps.detail: screener.in prints Stock P/E 7.16; stockanalysis.com prints PE Ratio 5.63. Both print price 95.00 and EPS 16.89. screener computes mcap/net-profit (post-IPO share count in the numerator), stockanalysis computes price/EPS (pre-IPO share count in the denominator). Neither page flags the mismatch, and screener.in's headline P/E is not reproducible from its own two adjacent tiles. An aggregator that picks one, or averages them, publishes a number with no meaning.

traps.name: 'Quarterly Results' table that contains half-years
traps.detail: BSE SME issuers file half-yearly. screener.in renders the half-yearly data under a 'Quarterly Results' heading with two columns labelled 'Mar 2025' and 'Mar 2026' (H2 FY25 sales 191, H2 FY26 sales 233). Reading these as quarters over-annualises by ~2x and reports a 'latest quarter' that is six months stale and six months long. Confirmed against the company's own board-meeting intimation: "...For The Half Year And Year Ended On March 31, 2026."

traps.name: Revenue is mostly gold pass-through - the scale trap the manifest flagged
traps.detail: FY2026 sales INR 432 cr against a market cap of INR 177 cr (0.41x P/S) and an operating margin of 8%, with INR 0 of fixed assets. This is a B2B jewellery distributor whose 'revenue' is largely the value of the gold passing through it. Any screen that ranks on price-to-sales, revenue growth or revenue-per-employee will mis-tier this against manufacturers, and a 'cheap on sales' verdict is an artifact of the metal price, not the business.

traps.name: Profit without cash - never positive FCF
traps.detail: FY2026: net profit +INR 25 cr, cash from operations -INR 16 cr, free cash flow -INR 17 cr, CFO/OP -34%. FCF has been negative or zero in all four years shown. Every headline tile (P/E 7.16, ROE 67%, ROCE 71.5%, profit growth 130%) is computed from the accrual line and none of them surface this. A terminal that shows only the tiles tells the user the opposite of what the cash flow says.

traps.name: Post-IPO share count vs pre-IPO balance sheet
traps.detail: The IPO closed 2026-06-03 and listed 2026-06-08 - AFTER the 2026-03-31 balance sheet date. Market cap uses ~1.865 cr shares; the filed equity capital of INR 15 cr implies 1.5 cr shares. Every per-share figure sourced from the FY26 filing (EPS, book value, net worth per share) is on the pre-issue base and is ~24% too high. Because the company reports half-yearly, no post-issue balance sheet exists until ~November 2026. There is currently NO correct book value in the world for this scrip - which is exactly why both screener.in and stockanalysis.com leave the field blank.
